data.summary: Moderna (MRNA) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: We plan to leverage our global production network, artificial intelligence (AI) and digital tools to improve cost efficiency. 3.
In addition, multiple integrated algorithms that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning optimize manufacturability, reduce failures and increase quality of mRNA sequences.
